notes.title: Official Game Guide Now Available!
notes.content:
By popular demand, the Official Game Guide for Fractal: Make Blooms Not War is now available at CipherPrime.com. This guide covers the mechanics and metrics for the different types of fractals, blooms, and game modes available.

For anyone interested in gameplay videos, check out these two on YouTube:
First Impressions of Fractal by PitFire GamingFractal Gameplay Video Feature by Giant Bomb
